messages:
maya: FYI — rolling canary of silica-11b-ptq4 showed a weird failure mode. A subset of code-generation prompts get truncated mid-token and end with garbled byte sequences. Repro on canary node r3-gpu-14.

oliver: ugh. seen anything in logs? request ids? :eyes:

maya: request ids: canary-req-98f4 and canary-req-9a12. Attached minimal repro below. This looks like token merge/fuse around long identifier boundaries after KV-cache flushes.

maya: ```
# prompt (truncated for thread)
"""
Write a python function to compute fibonacci(n) with memoization.
Provide the full code block including imports and tests.
"""
# output ends abruptly here in canary-req-98f4:
"``
``\u0000\u0000\u0000def fib(n):
    if n in memo:
        return memo[n]
    if n <= 1:
        return n
    memo[n] = fib(n-1) + fib(n-2)
    return memo[n]
```

maya: Notice the NUL bytes and the code fence closure missing. This only appears on ptq4 variants; fp16 and q8 are fine.

sam: interesting. does it correlate with sequence length or batch boundaries? can you repro with single request (no batch)?

maya: yes repros with batch_size=1 when there is a KV-cache rewind event (we do an internal prefix flush). If we disable prefix caching it behaves normally — so likely a KV cache + quantized decode kernel edge-case.

oliver: can you paste the decoder logs around token emit for that req id? especially the token merge/compact traces.

maya: ```
[2026-03-12T14:02:12Z] decode: step 128 token_emit id=562, logprob=-1.02
[2026-03-12T14:02:12Z] decode: kv-cache rewind triggered by policy=prompt-shortcut
[2026-03-12T14:02:12Z] quant-kernel: remap mergebound indices (path=attn_fused)
[2026-03-12T14:02:12Z] decode: step 129 token_emit id=563, raw_bytes=0x00 0x00 0xe2
[2026-03-12T14:02:12Z] decode: stream closed unexpectedly (err=EPIPE)\n```

luca: could be an alignment issue in the fused attention kernel after quant remap. PTQ packing sometimes changes alignment assumptions. I'll repro locally with ASAN build.

anya: add the prompt set from customer-repro channel to a small test harness and run with determinism flags — we should catch the raw token stream mismatch in CI. Also tag @ops-bot for canary rollback if it hits >=0.5% errors.

ops-bot: Alert: canary silica-11b-ptq4 failure rate 0.62% over last 10m. Marking canary unstable. Initiating automatic rollback window countdown (5m) unless resolved.

sam: thanks. prioritize: 1) reproduce in unit harness (luca) 2) add detection (anya) 3) roll back canary (ops-bot) if still failing. Maya, can you gather model artifact hashes & quantization script args and drop them in the thread?

maya: dropping artifacts: model_hash=sha256:8f3b...d1, quant_script=ptq_v2_mergebound.py --bits=4 --pack=packed. Also noting we used kernel-build tag v3.2. Will upload test case to s3://redwood-dev/ml-repro/silica-mergebound/canary-98f4.tar.gz

oliver: perfect. if local ASAN repro shows out-of-bounds, we may need to push a quick kernel patch or revert to packed layout v2. ops-bot, keep the rollback timer running.

luca: starting ASAN run now. ETA 35m. if I reproduce, I'll post stack and minimal C++ snippet.

anya: I'll add a lightweight CI test that asserts no NULs in streamed output and fails the build if detected. Quick guard while we debug.

maya: thanks team. filing a short postlaunch ticket with links: https://redwood-internal/issue/ML-3452 and will attach the repro and logs. Keeping this thread updated :thumbsup:
